sanskrit_verse:
कालकर्मात्मबीजानां दोषैर् मातुस् तथैव च ।
गर्भस्य वैकृतं दृष्टम् अङ्गहीनादि जन्मनः ॥
transliteration: kālakarmātmabījānāṃ doṣair mātuḥ tathaiva ca / garbhasya vaikṛtaṃ dṛṣṭam aṅgahīnādi janmanaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: Defects in conception, arising from time, action, seed, maternal condition, or elemental imbalance, result in bodily imperfection or absence at birth.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from causal completeness, not defective manifestation
Causation is multi-layered: temporal, karmic, genetic, maternal, elemental
Capacity-based responsibility lies with those who govern procreative alignment
Restoration logic requires correction at the causal level, not post-birth adjustment
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of embodiment as dependent on harmonious causation
executable_legal_axioms: IF conception occurs under known causal defect THEN progeny's rights are preserved through compensatory societal integration
IF maternal or paternal lineage knowingly introduces causal disorder THEN lineage bears obligation for corrective support
IF temporal or ritual misalignment contributes to embryonic defect THEN community adjusts conditions to restore harmony
IF physical imperfection arises THEN social structures shall ensure full participation without diminishment of status
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters involving congenital disability, the Supreme Court must recognize that defect inheres in causation, not personhood. Responsibility flows to agents capable of causal intervention—parents, lineage, society—and restoration must occur through systemic alignment, not punitive attribution.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that imperfection manifests sequentially from kāla, karma, bīja, and maternal condition. Since the individual is not the agent of their own causation, suffering or diminishment is unjust. Nyaya demands alignment with the sequential truth of manifestation and restoration through conscious societal duty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Processes: Ensure all causal agents undergo dharmic rectification through purification and alignment rituals
Responsibility Assumption Protocols: Lineage and governing bodies assume duty of lifelong support and integration
Capacity Restoration: Provide technological, spiritual, and communal means for maximal embodiment of consciousness
Integrity Reintegration: Society adapts structures to allow full participation and dignity of being
final_declaration: This law proceeds from the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Defect is of causation, not being; Dharma is restored by aligning future conditions, not punishing past events; Reality is non-punitive; Consciousness alone is the final adjudicator.
